message.content:
**Answer:**  
The sculpture most frequently cited as the quintessential masterpiece of the 19th century is **Auguste Rodin’s “The Kiss” (1888‑1889)**. Created during the late Romantic period, it exemplifies Rodin’s innovative approach to form and emotion and has become an icon of modern sculpture worldwide.  

*(For comparison, Rodin’s later “The Thinker” (1902‑1904) is arguably the most famous sculpture overall, but it belongs to the early 20th century.)*
